provider: CNB 云原生构建 (cnb.cool, Tencent Cloud Native Build, community edition)

free_tier.stated: **对象存储：** 制品、LFS 对象、图片及附件占用的存储空间，免费额度 `100GiB`。
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: the official attachments plugin states a 64 GB ceiling per uploaded file

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: unverified: no attachment retention or deletion period is stated on the pricing or attachment-plugin pages read

egress.terms: Pricing table specifies 仓库存储 and 对象存储 by GiB-month without a separate egress traffic row. Public release-attachment downloads run through the cnb.cool CDN.

tooling: OpenList ships a first-class `cnb_releases` driver (github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList, drivers/cnb_releases. Fields: repo, token, use_tag_name, default_branch), i.e. a maintained WebDAV/HTTP front end over CNB release attachments. Also the official `cnbcool/attachments` plugin ('支持 commit 和 release 上传或下载附件，目前暂支持 64GB 以内的文件上传') and a Rust CLI (`cnb release download/--share`).
chaining: Free allowance is per top-level organization ('每个顶级组织独立计费') providing 200 GiB each. Repositories support releases with attachments up to 64 GB per file.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: 64 GB per release/commit attachment (provider's own plugin README: '目前暂支持 64GB 以内的文件上传'). repo-blob cap: 256 MB per file in the git tree, with the maintainers explicitly steering large files to release attachments ('此256M之限制..当以附件方式为之'). request-rate: none documented. Billing: over the free 100 GiB the org is charged ¥1/GiB/month at month start. Silent overage, not a hard stop.

identity_cost.detail: national-id (WeChat login / 腾讯云 account; the docs' usage-management flow binds a Tencent Cloud budget). Not anonymous.

reliability_note: Community edition launched public beta 2025-08; beta-free extras expired 2025-08-31, so the 100+100 GiB figures are the steady state. No ban/wipe reports found; overage is billed rather than blocked, which is the real hazard.

notes: Per top-level org, free tier per month: '仓库存储 100 GiB' + '对象存储 100 GiB' (object storage covers '制品、LFS 对象、图片及附件'), plus 160 build-CPU core-hours and 1600 dev-CPU core-hours. Over-quota is metered at ¥1/GiB/month, and storage is billed on daily average minus the free allowance. So staying under 100+100 GiB per org is genuinely free.

extras.egress_verbatim: Not metered separately in the pricing table — the only storage line items are 仓库存储 and 对象存储, both by GiB-month; there is no egress/流量 row. Public release-attachment downloads run on the cnb.cool CDN. Treat as unmetered-until-proven; I did not find an egress line to quote.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Free allowance is per *top-level org*, and '每个顶级组织独立计费' — so N orgs = N x 200 GiB. Two independent multipliers: (a) unlimited repos inside one org, each with unlimited releases, each attachment up to 64 GB; (b) unlimited orgs at 200 GiB each. 10 TiB hot = ~100 orgs at the free ceiling, or 160 release attachments at 64 GB in a single org. Per-file ceiling (64 GB) is 32x GitHub Releases' 2 GiB.

extras.agent_focus: systematic GitHub keyword sweep (EN + zh-CN + ja + ru) for projects that advertise free/unlimited storage, used as a discovery net to surface named providers and wrappers not yet in the corpus

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
